verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents API credentials (client id/secret and a connection key) that are issued manually on request via api@puzzle.io. The evidence never mentions scopes, permission levels, read-only keys, or per-agent least-privilege credentials, and the MCP setup docs only describe connecting an account to Claude, so the story's capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
